spotlights.title: Registration is open!
spotlights.content: Get your tickets for Howloween, UCSD's very own furry mini-con! Our event is open to everyone, including furries, cosplayers, and more, whether you're a UCSD student or not.

spotlights.title: Want to stay updated?
spotlights.content: If you want to stay updated on news related to the event, you should join our Discord server or Telegram announcement channel :3

spotlights.title: Get involved!
spotlights.content: Do you have an idea for a panel or art you want to sell? Or even just want to help make this event happen in any way you can? We currently have applications open for many different aspects of the event, so apply while you still can!

spotlights.title: What is Howloween?
spotlights.content:
Howloween is an annual Halloween-themed mini convention at UC San Diego, hosted by Triton Tails, UCSD's resident furry club. Attendees can enjoy a wide range of activities, from vendor fairs and gaming to costume and dance competitions, night raves, and more!

 Howloween started in 2024 with just an artist alley and a couple of rooms. Since then, it has grown into a much larger event, bringing in many different student orgs on campus for collaboration and hundreds of attendees each year.

guests.name: DoodleDrawz
guests.description:
🎨 Doodle Drawz is a proud advocate for those with chronic illness/disabilities. Having one himself, Doodle always looks for opportunities to advocate for representation for those with chronic illnesses or disabilities in the fandom. He’s also a proud member and advocate for the Trans 🏳️‍⚧️  and Asexual 🖤 🩶 🤍 💜 community as well! 

Doodle is a dedicated fursuit maker of 5 years, and a furry artist of 10+ years, who has won two floor wars competitions 🕺 🪩

  🎃 We are SO excited to have them as one of this year's Howloween Special Guests, and you can see them at this year’s Vendor Fair, or a Special Sponsor Q&A Panel as well! 🎃

guests.name: Benji Maru
guests.description:
Benji is a lovely artist who has amassed a following from their cozy and inclusive art. He even made his own silhouette and reveal art.  He has also delved into fursuit making, having made fursuits for himself and his boyfriend. 

✨ We are so excited to have Benji as our THIRD Guest of Honor for Howloween, and hope you all are too! ✨
